responsibility: Rewrites RTL after regional IRA allocation when the same pseudo receives different assignments in nested regions. It creates new pseudos and allocnos for split live ranges, generates border shuffle moves on basic-block and edge boundaries, resolves swaps and redundant motion, updates allocno live ranges/copies/costs for inserted code, and commits edge insertions while re-recognizing affected insns. This is the stage that flattens regional IRA decisions into a single RTL form suitable for reload or LRA.
